title: 第23章 打得一拳出第24章 真金火炼
content_zh:
陈知白眉头微蹙，语气平静道：“师兄找错了人，陈某并不做生意。”
汤沐霖顿时笑了起来：“你当然不做生意，因为生意都是礼云极在做。”
陈知白心中一沉。
果然，这事瞒不过有心人，尤其是在以驭兽闻名的老律观，想要盯梢一个人，太简单了。
他略一沉吟，开口道：
“师兄若有需要，匀一只五趾雀尾鸡，也不是不可以。”
“陈师弟果然是性情中人，不过，我不要五趾雀尾鸡，我要五趾雀尾蛋。”
“足月五趾雀尾鸡可以，但鸡蛋不行。”
汤沐霖笑容一僵，往前踏了半步，半边身子欺近院内：
“我只要蛋，价钱好商量，若嫌不够，我再添两千两白银，如何？”
陈知白摇头，语气依旧不变：
“若是足月五趾雀尾鸡，两千两我便能卖，但五趾雀尾蛋，卖不了，我也没有。”
他就知道，半夜登门，多半有鬼。
若只要五趾雀尾鸡，那还能说是冲着其特殊龙纹而来。
现在只要蛋，陈知白用脚指头都能猜出他想干什么？
无外乎是做那掮客生意，卖给一些富贵人家，钻老律观云栖院规则空子，免去三年杂役和考核，破格授箓。
汤沐霖脸上笑意收敛，压低声音：
“师弟能卖蛋给礼云极，却不肯卖给我，莫不是瞧不上汤某？”
“并非此意。”
“那便是觉得我出价低了？”

汤沐霖又走近一步，初玄大乘气息肆意迸发：
“有些事，大家心照不宣便好，若让门中知道你私售五趾雀尾鸡，云栖院又屡屡出现破格杂役，你说门中该如何处置？”
这话说得客气，威胁之意溢于言表。
陈知白抬眼看着他，忽然叹了口气。
汤沐霖以为他意动，嘴角刚刚勾起，不想，陈知白脑袋微微后仰，便是如炮弹般狠狠砸在他的鼻梁上。
“砰！”
一声闷响，汤沐霖猝不及防，鼻梁剧痛，眼前金星乱冒，酸泪霎时涌出。
“啊——”
他失声痛呼，还未反应过来，陈知白钵大的拳头，已然抡了上来。
“砰！”
“你！”
“吼——”
content_en:
Chen Zhibai frowned slightly and said in a calm tone: "Senior brother, you have found the wrong person. Chen is not doing business."
Tang Mulin suddenly laughed: "Of course you don't do business, because Li Yunji is doing the business."
Chen Zhibai's heart sank.
As expected, this matter cannot be hidden from anyone who is interested, especially in Laoluguan, which is famous for its beast control. It is too easy to keep track of a person.
He pondered for a moment and then said:
"Senior brother, if necessary, it is not impossible to feed a five-toed sparrow-tailed chicken."
"Junior Brother Chen is indeed a sweetheart, but I don't want a five-toed sparrow chicken, I want a five-toed sparrow egg."
"Full-term five-toed sparrows are OK, but eggs are not."
Tang Mulin's smile froze, and he took half a step forward, leaning half of his body closer to the courtyard:
"I only want eggs, and the price is negotiable. If it's not enough, how about I add another two thousand taels of silver?"
Chen Zhibai shook his head, his tone remained unchanged:
"If it's a full-term five-toed sparrow chicken, I can sell it for two thousand taels, but five-toed sparrow eggs can't be sold, and I don't have any."
He knew that if he came to the door in the middle of the night, there was probably a ghost.
If you only want the five-toed sparrow-tail chicken, it can be said that it comes for its special dragon pattern.
Now, as long as he has eggs, Chen Zhibai can guess with his toes what he wants to do?
It's nothing more than doing the brokerage business, selling to some wealthy families, taking advantage of the loopholes in the rules of Laoluguan Yunqiyuan, exempting them from three years of chores and examinations, and granting them special orders.
The smile on Tang Mulin's face faded and he lowered his voice:
"Junior brother can sell eggs to Li Yunji, but refuses to sell them to me. Could it be that he despises Tang?"
"That's not what I meant."
"So you think my bid is low?"
Tang Mulin took another step closer, and the Chuxuan Mahayana breath burst out wantonly:
"There are some things that should be tacitly understood by everyone. If the sect knows that you are selling five-toed sparrow-tailed chickens privately, and there are frequent irregularities in Yunqiyuan, what do you think the sect should do?"
This was said politely, but the threat was palpable.
Chen Zhibai looked up at him and suddenly sighed.
Tang Mulin thought he was moving and just raised the corners of his mouth. Unexpectedly, Chen Zhibai tilted his head back slightly and hit him hard on the bridge of the nose like a cannonball.
"Bang!"
There was a muffled sound, and Tang Mulin was caught off guard. The bridge of his nose hurt sharply, stars appeared in front of his eyes, and sour tears suddenly poured out of his eyes.
"Ah——"
He cried out in pain, but before he could react, Chen Zhibai's huge fist had already come up.
"Bang!"
"You!"
"Roar——"
